description: This is a JUnit test class for the AuthorService in a book management application. It tests various methods such as findById, findAll, save, delete, deleteAll, and count, using Mockito to mock dependencies and AssertJ for assertions.

classes.name: AuthorServiceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for AuthorService, testing CRUD operations and exception handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the AuthorService with a mocked AuthorRepository before each test.

methods.name: findById_throwsException_ifIdIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that findById throws NullPointerException when passed null.

methods.name: canFindByNonNullId
methods.description: Verifies that findById calls the repository's findById method with a non-null ID.

methods.name: canFindAll
methods.description: Verifies that findAll calls the repository's findAll method.

methods.name: save_throwsException_ifAuthorIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that save throws NullPointerException when passed null.

methods.name: authorSavedIfNotNull
methods.description: Verifies that a non-null Author object is saved correctly via the repository.

methods.name: delete_throwsException_ifAuthorIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that delete throws NullPointerException when passed null.

methods.name: authorDeletedIfNotNull
methods.description: Verifies that a non-null Author object is deleted correctly via the repository.

methods.name: canDeleteAll
methods.description: Verifies that deleteAll calls the repository's deleteAll method.

methods.name: canCount
methods.description: Verifies that count calls the repository's count method.
